review_candidates.title: Proposal Manager
review_candidates.description: Solutions & Proposal Manager We are growing our team at Shaffra and are looking for a Solutions & Proposal Manager to own the development of our enterprise proposals from initial opportunity through final submission. This role sits between Sales, Product, Engineering and Project Management . It is not simply a proposal-writing role. You will be responsible for understanding what the customer needs, shaping the right solution, coordinating all the required internal inputs and turning that into a proposal that is commercially strong, technically correct and realistic to deliver. About the role You will work across complex enterprise and government opportunities and take ownership of the full proposal process. You will work with Sales to understand the opportunity and customer requirements, with technical teams to validate the solution, with Project Management to define timelines and delivery, and with management to align commercials and pricing. Your job is to bring all of this together into one clear proposal. Responsibilities Proposal Ownership: Own the full proposal process from initial scoping through final submission. Solution Scoping: Translate customer requirements into clear use cases, solution components, workflows and deliverables. Technical Coordination: Work with Product and Engineering to validate architecture, integrations, infrastructure, data and technical requirements. User Experience Scoping: Define how the proposed solution will work for the customer and its end users. Delivery Planning: Work with Project Management to define implementation phases, timelines, milestones, dependencies and responsibilities. Commercial Coordination: Work with Sales and management on pricing, commercial structure, implementation fees, recurring fees and optional items. RFPs & Tenders: Coordinate and prepare responses to RFPs, RFIs and enterprise tenders. Scope Control: Clearly define assumptions, dependencies, exclusions and customer responsibilities. Proposal Quality: Ensure every proposal is clear, customer-specific, commercially aligned and technically accurate. Internal Coordination: Drive all relevant teams to provide the required inputs within proposal deadlines. Sales-to-Delivery Handover: Make sure what was sold is clearly handed over to Project Management and Delivery once the opportunity is won. Proposal Library: Build and maintain reusable technical, commercial and company content to improve both speed and quality of future proposals. What we are looking for Experience in enterprise software, technology, AI, digital transformation or systems integration Strong experience preparing technical and commercial proposals Ability to understand customer requirements and translate them into clear solutions Good technical understanding without necessarily being a developer Strong commercial awareness Ability to understand pricing, project scope and delivery implications Experience working across Sales, Product, Engineering and Delivery teams Strong written communication and presentation skills Very strong attention to detail Comfortable managing multiple opportunities and deadlines at the same time Comfortable challenging unclear requirements or unrealistic commitments Highly organized and able to drive different teams toward a deadline Experience with enterprise or government RFPs and tenders is a strong advantage Good understanding of the Saudi and GCC enterprise market is a plus Experience within AI, SaaS, enterprise platforms, system integration, consulting or pre-sales would be particularly relevant. Who you are You take ownership. You are structured and highly organized. You can understand both commercial and technical conversations. You are comfortable asking questions until the scope is clear. You can speak to a salesperson, project manager and engineer and understand what each one needs. You do not simply collect information. You challenge it, structure it and turn it into a strong solution. You care about both winning the project and making sure it can actually be delivered. And most importantly, you enjoy turning complex customer requirements into something simple and clear. Why Shaffra Impact: Work directly on proposals for some of the largest enterprises and government organizations in the GCC. Technology: Help shape an Enterprise AI Workforce platform at a time when the market is moving extremely fast. Exposure: Work directly across commercial, technical, product and delivery teams. Ownership: Take responsibility for one of the most important parts of our enterprise sales process. Growth: Be part of Shaffra as we continue scaling across the GCC and internationally. We don’t expect every strong candidate to tick every single box. Our first level interview is run through Shaffra AI, so if you believe you can do the job, apply and show us. Solutions & Proposal Manager: [https://www.shaffra.com/careers?role=solutions-proposal-manager-pre-sales] #Hiring #PreSales #SolutionConsulting #ProposalManagement #EnterpriseAI #AI #GenAI #SaudiArabia #GCC #Shaffra

Experience organizing academic conferences, workshops, and seminars.

Reporting to the PMC Director is a unique opportunity to shape and grow our Data Centre division, delivering for the best clients in Europe. This is a high-impact leadership role responsible for driving consistency, governance, and performance across planning, cost management, risk, procurement, and project delivery. This role will partner with senior stakeholders to ensure predictable, efficient, and high-quality execution across the full project lifecycle from early development through to commissioning and handover. Location: Flexible – this role can be based from any PM Group office across our global network. Closing date for applications is Friday 31st July . Responsibilities Leadership & Strategy: Define and deliver a best-in-class project controls strategy aligned to regional and organisational goals Establish governance, standards, best practices and processes to drive consistency and performance across all projects Partner with executive leadership to support strategic decision-making and delivery planning Build, lead, and develop a high-performing, internationally distributed team Foster strong collaboration across functions creating a consistent approach to project controls. Champion diversity, equity, inclusion, and a positive team culture throughout the organisation Project Controls Excellence: Oversee planning, scheduling, cost management, procurement, and contract administration Ensure robust project execution strategies and resource planning across programmes Provide expert oversight and peer review to identify risk and optimisation opportunities Implement progress measurement frameworks with regional benchmarking to monitor productivity, performance, and milestone adherence Drive data driven cost optimisation initiatives and regional cost benchmarking Drive standardisation across multiple projects and geographies Performance, Risk & Reporting: Implement data-driven frameworks to monitor cost, schedule, and productivity performance Lead risk management across the project portfolio, including mitigation and reporting strategies Deliver clear, accurate, and timely reporting to executive stakeholders Maintain cost intelligence and drive continuous cost optimisation Champion a culture of accountability, performance, and continuous enhancement across all delivery functions. Q uality, Governance & Compliance: Establish and enforce QA/QC standards across all delivery phases Ensure compliance with regulatory, contractual, and internal requirements Lead audits and embed continuous improvement initiatives Digital Transformation & Innovation: Champion the use of digital tools, automation, and analytics in project controls Enhance reporting, transparency, and decision-making through real-time data Drive process improvement and operational efficiency across the function Stakeholder & Supply Chain Engagement Collaborate closely with project, construction, and commercial teams Support procurement strategies and contractor selection Build strong relationships with clients, partners, and industry stakeholders Qualifications Qualifications & Experience Degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Quantity Surveying or a related discipline Extensive experience in project controls, programme management, or major capital projects Proven leadership experience in complex construction environments (e.g. data centres, pharma, infrastructure, or mission-critical projects) Expertise in planning, cost control, risk management, and reporting systems Strong understanding of regional construction markets and regulatory environments Track record of driving standardisation, transformation, and performance improvement Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills Strong competency in governance, process improvement, digital transformation, and risk-based decision making Key Attributes Excellent communicator and client-facing leader. Results-oriented, with a focus on measurable outcomes and continuous improvement. Collaborative, adaptable, and resilient—able to inspire teams and navigate change. Passionate about technology and its potential to transform business operations. Why PM Group? As an employee-owned company, we are inclusive, committed and driven. review_candidates.location: Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
review_candidates.description: Mace combines construction expertise with consultancy to unlock potential in every person or project and redefine the boundaries of ambition. Our values shape the way we consult and define the people we want to join us on our journey. The Project Mace is supporting the delivery of a large‑scale, next‑generation digital infrastructure programme in the region, working alongside a leading developer in the data centre sector. The project brings together complex design coordination, fast‑paced delivery and rigorous governance to meet the demands of a mission‑critical environment. Our team is applying global best practice in programme, project and commercial management to help shape resilient, future‑ready infrastructure at scale You’ll Be Responsible For Directs preparation and formal execution of contract documents, including warranties, bonds, and licenses, ensuring compliance with contractual and approval requirements. Manages large teams of direct reports, driving appropriate behaviours, performance against KPIs, and a strong continuous improvement culture. Drives accurate measurement of valuations to maintain effective cost control and robust financial reporting. Directs the preparation and presentation of monthly post-contract cost reports to clients. Proactively identifies and manages cost impacts arising from design changes, contract awards, construction activities, and client instructions. Oversees the assessment and determination of contractor and subcontractor claims relating to delay and additional costs. Directs the issue of certificates for practical completion, making good defects, and final completion to enable final account agreement. Leads cost consultants to improve cost management processes, systems, and best practices, while supporting net zero carbon objectives through proactive carbon reduction management. You’ll Need To Have Necessary visa criteria for the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and have relevant work experience working on high valued projects/ programmes for a project management consultancy business, which are required for immigration and client approval. Degree in quantity surveying/cost management (or equivalent). Professional membership i.e. MRICS/RICS (or equivalent). Strong Bidding and business development experience. Strong commercial and financial acumen. Sound knowledge of value engineering, life cycle costing, contract law and contractual frameworks relating to construction. Management experience within large, diverse teams. Experience of managing relationships with key senior stakeholders. Our values Safety first - Going home safe and well: We champion a safe, diverse and inclusive working environment, understanding the importance of wellbeing in every team. Client focus - Deliver on our promise: We own the quality of deliverables, strategic outcomes and build long term relationships with our clients. Integrity - Always do the right thing: We influence positive outcomes within our industry, while always aligning with our compliance obligations. Create opportunity - For our people to excel: We champion a continuous improvement culture throughout all activities, inspiring our people and teams to develop. Mace is an inclusive employer and welcomes interest from a diverse range of candidates. Even if you feel you do not fulfil all the criteria, please apply as you may still be the best candidate for this role or another role within our organisation. We are also open to discussing part time, flexible, and hybrid working options if suitable with-in the role
